title: Prohibition on Chinese Humanoid Robotic Systems (FY2027 NDAA markup item)
summary: Gooden’s markup log item 6312, revision 2, was agreed to by voice vote. The House-passed FY2027 NDAA contains a related Section 163 barring DoD procurement, leasing or obtaining of covered humanoid robotic systems made or developed by foreign adversaries, or carrying their software, AI, cloud or remote-control services. A controlled-testing waiver and exclusions for fixed industrial robots, non-networked systems and regulated medical devices apply.
mechanism_scope_limitations: Section 163 applies to contracts and agreements after enactment and requires implementation guidance within 180 days. It is not a general civilian possession ban. The markup log identifies Gooden’s contribution but does not independently prove verbatim continuity into Section 163; the House-passed text establishes that section’s scope. House passage is not enactment.

quotes.quote: The Secretary of Defense may not procure, lease, or otherwise obtain a covered humanoid robotic system

unresolved_discrepancies: Exact amendment-to-section lineage not independently established; related operative text verified in House-passed §163.
